verdict.rationale: GitHub offers GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows in the repository (github-docs-38, github-docs-11). It also advertises extending your stack with marketplace "apps, actions" (github-docs-10) and "tools from the community and partners" (github-docs-35), and the marketplace lists third-party CI/CD integrations (github-intdir-1, github-intdir-7). The evidence is mostly marketing-level and only implies that community actions can be referenced inside workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of how community actions are referenced and versioned in workflow files, a dedicated Actions marketplace listing (the cited pages are the apps marketplace), and independent or hands-on corroboration of reusing community actions.
